== English Coruscant comparison ==
The 0 side keeps the original text. July 2007 explicitly required drawing a card for battle destiny unless canceled. Its p.29 describes a substituted destiny as having no physical card draw, so AR2's wording spells out the same trigger. The earlier rulebook final loss clause lacks its subject, while original, 2023 and current full/printable faces say opponent. Retain both independently sourced renditions and one PC gameplay state. Neither the omitted subject nor pinned JSON's shorthand warrants a further state.
